scope: Required test criteria for the next deployable 1.10 package.

catechism_essentials: Each module has one descriptive H1 and ordered module headings.
Official CCC links have descriptive text and open the intended official page.
Scripture links expose book, chapter, and verse/range in accessible names.
Progress state works by keyboard and is announced without relying on color alone.
relationship_catalog: Every visible relationship includes its stable record ID and provenance limitation.
Filter changes announce result counts to screen readers.
Downloadable packets include the validation questions and moderation boundary.
No label calls a Review relationship verified, peer-reviewed, direct quotation, or doctrine without a specific approved source tier.
community_feedback: Form validation errors identify the affected field and preserve the user response.
Submission acknowledgement explains moderation status and does not imply publication.
Keyboard-only completion and mobile layout pass.
A published privacy and copyright notice is linked immediately before submission.
timeline: Traditional and approximate dates include visible precision labels.
Event source tier and link are available in the selected-event panel.
Events without a selected source display a review-needed label rather than a blank authority cue.
